title: Black Hawk Sport Fishing
specs: Only fish between 28-31 inches can be kept- any that are smaller or bigger must be released.
This trip is geared towards families and children; all adults must be accompanied by a child.
If you loose gear (such as hooks, sinkers, jigs, etc.) it must be paid for and replaced on the boat.
There is no minimum age for fishing on the Black Hawk.

faq.q: What do I need to bring with me on the boat?
faq.a: Wear close-toed shoes (no flip flops or sandals), bring a cooler if you’d like, snacks, drinks (no glass containers or hard alcohol), sunscreen, a hat, sweatshirt/raincoat, your camera, and your excitement!
